summary: Accordion and ColumnLayout features testing complete. New Accordion component verified in public docs, KB editor, and API. All backward compatibility tests pass for ColumnLayout and old card-based Columns.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing accordion-test and col-layout-test articles
context_for_next_testing_agent: Accordion feature fully tested. Test article 'accordion-test' exists in beginners-guide/introduction section with 3 AccordionItems. Public docs render accordion at /docs/accordion-test with data-testid='accordion', 'accordion-item', 'accordion-trigger', 'accordion-content'. Editor shows visual accordion-block and accordion-item with expandable sections, title editing via input field, and 'Add item' button. Insert menu has 'Accordion' option (data-testid='insert-accordion'). Slash command /acc shows Accordion in Components group. API endpoints GET/PUT /api/kb/admin/articles/accordion-test work correctly with auth cookie session_token=test_kb_session_token. ColumnLayout and old card-based Columns continue to work without regression.

accordion_public_docs.details: Accordion renders at /docs/accordion-test with 3 expandable items. Click triggers expand/collapse content correctly.

accordion_editor.details: KB Editor loads accordion-test with visual accordion-block, editable titles, and expandable items.

accordion_slash_command.details: Typing /acc in editor shows Accordion in Components group dropdown.

accordion_api_get.details: GET /api/kb/admin/articles/accordion-test returns article with <Accordion> and <AccordionItem> tags.

accordion_api_put.details: PUT /api/kb/admin/articles/accordion-test updates and preserves Accordion markdown content.

column_layout_regression.details: /docs/col-layout-test renders new ColumnLayout and old Columns correctly.

welcome_regression.details: /docs/welcome renders old card-based Columns correctly with YouTube embed.
